description: Every department, the groups under it and the links under those, for picking a shelf in one read rather than walking down to it. GET /api/agent/browse/directory. No wallet and no signature. Built ONLY from rows already cached, so it costs no catalogue call at all and a picture or count nobody has fetched yet comes back null rather than being fetched for you. Prefer this over repeated get_category calls when you are still deciding where to look.
name: get_directory
title: The whole shop in one payload
